title: RELAY: Scaling Historical Build Restoration through Rule Reuse and Agentic Repair
abstract: arXiv:2610.27784v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vulnerability benchmarks and software engineering research depend on rebuilding historical software. Yet builds rely on external resources, such as base images and packages, that change independently of the source code. In this study, we examine this environment decay on 14,159 OSS-Fuzz cases. We find that 69.7% no longer complete reconstruction and verification, and that most failures share a small number of recurring failure symptoms. A recurring failure can therefore be diagnosed once and its repair reused. We present Relay, a hybrid framework that uses an LLM to derive and validate deterministic repair rules from representative failures, reuses them without model calls, and escalates cases unresolved by rules to a per-case agent. We evaluate Relay in human-guided and fully automated rule-derivation campaigns and compare it with a per-case agent approach. translated_title: RELAY：通过规则复用与智能体修复实现历史构建恢复的规模化
translated_abstract: 漏洞基准测试和软件工程研究依赖于对历史软件的重新构建。然而，构建过程依赖于外部资源，例如基础镜像和软件包，这些资源的变化独立于源代码。在本研究中，我们在14,159个OSS-Fuzz案例上考察了这种“环境衰退”现象。我们发现，69.7%的案例已无法完成重建与验证，且大多数失败共享少数几种反复出现的故障症状。因此，一个反复出现的故障只需诊断一次，其修复方案即可被复用。我们提出了Relay，一个混合框架：它利用大语言模型（LLM）从代表性故障中推导并验证确定性的修复规则，在不调用模型的情况下复用这些规则，并将规则无法解决的案例升级为由逐案例的智能体处理。我们在人工引导和全自动规则推导两种模式下评估了Relay，并将其与逐案例智能体方法进行比较。我们发现规则推导可以实现完全自动化，且可复用的规则……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: Relay是一个混合框架，它利用LLM从代表性构建失败中自动推导并验证可复用的确定性修复规则，将规则无法解决的少数案例交给智能体逐案修复，从而规模化地恢复了历史软件（14,159个OSS-Fuzz案例中近七成因环境衰退而无法重建）的构建。
en_tdlr: RELAY is a hybrid framework that uses an LLM to automatically derive reusable deterministic repair rules from representative build failures and escalates only unresolved cases to a per-case agent, enabling scalable restoration of historical software builds affected by environment decay.
